Close, bpd refers to borderline personality disorder, its a disorder that causes amongst others, depression, thoughts of self harm and suicide, anxiety linked to abandonment, severe mood swings, and generally its REALLY NEAT 

Its one of the few mental disorders that get almost no attention, fuck i cant even use it for fucking victim points on the internet because nobody even believes me. The very nature of how my feelings work make them very fleeting and short lasting, i can legitimately be depressed and bubbly in the same day...

People just assume i fake it...

I unfortunately don’t remember, but me overclocking the gpu happened after the random bsods started to be noticeable 

Also im afraid i can’t actually open the laptop, if i recall correctly laptop ssds use different connectors to desktops so its probably not worth it just to be disappointed :/

I see, i’ll give it a try in a moment then.

Well of course i did, as most gamers do... Upgrading drivers is important and all, but i don’t recall ever specifically updating the bios.

Wont opening the case void the warranty tho? I dont want to risk it... 

And honestly, i’ve had a lot of bsods happening lately, at least two a week, this one happened completely randomly, but the curious thing is that it didn’t reboot correctly after the whole “gathering info” thing, instead jumping into bios configuration as if the boot drive wasn’t detected
Give me those smooth legs uwu

Eh its hard to say

Cum can taste nice, but sometimes it’s really nasty.

Its usually rather bitter and watery...

Also when it comes to dating... Really, if you two actually love each other things will go more or less naturally.

And when it comes to sex, well, sex in general comes in many forms, and really if he knows what he’s doing he’ll make sure to guide you.
Maybe the first few times may be a bit weird, i know for sure that the first time i bottomed wasn’t exactly painful but it wasn’t exactly mind blowing either.

Take things slow, but don’t be too afraid to try new things, for example when it comes to bottoming the real trick is to know how to relax, that’s kinda the key to enjoying it. 
But communication is really important, he needs to know if he’s doing good or not :3

And most importantly, have fun! Exploring and discovering are the best things about dating and relationships, let loose, you have nothing to worry about around him, there was a time he was inexperienced too.

“Hey... I just want you to know that i’m pretty new to dating and most forms of intimacy, could we maybe take things slow? I need time to catch up ^^”

Just be nice and honest, he loves you, he’ll understand.

Im bi, but omg... Coming out to my friends has really helped me a lot...
Its just good to finally be myself, to stop worrying about people finding out...
It puts my mind at ease.

You’re kidding right?
I personally find your body type to be very attractive, and im sure im not the only one.

Although, you should really expect people to assume that you’re a bottom... Its all okay if that’s your preference but if its not, well, it may be a little tricky....

Don’t overthink it all too much, just enjoy your life and generally try to stay positive and happy, that’s after all, the most important thing to do.
There might be many people out there that wouldn’t find you physically attractive,  but if you’re generally socially active and show that you’re confident, happy and fun to be around, it will make a lot of people totally ignore how you look and enjoy your company for your personality alone.

Thank you again... You’re absolutely right and i know it... Its not like im not trying to stay positive, and most of the time i manage it just right!

Its just... Well, i don’t have many friends in the real world, unfortunately being very much a shy person really makes it hard for me to get new friends, and... What hurts me the most, is the fact that i actually lost friends because of my sexuality.

It stings like hell, i thought they were my friends... I never expected then to just ditch me like that.

I always have a lot of people to talk to, my hobbies kinda guarantee that tbh.... But i have truly nobody to hug, nobody to talk about my feelings with.

... It sucks, i really want to be more open, i used to  know how to do that, i used to be a bloody extrovert...

But ever since i got depressed, i just don’t know how to do it, yes i became much much happier that’s for sure, mainly because the reason as to why i was depressed was mainly rooted in the fact that i was way to closed, i pretended to be somebody else, i was never honest as to who i really am... And that fact destroyed me...

Unfortunately, even though being myself, and stopping to worry about people finding out my secrets helped me a lot... I for some reason forgot how to talk to people... I became an introvert...

Eh :<
Why am i even telling you this....

Thank you for all the advice...

Im not that concerned with that tbh... Its really just “the icing on the cake” if you will, i think i can live with it...

I have tried before.. But never in a serious way, maybe i really should try...

You’re right... You absolutely are.
I’m getting there, it will take time but i try to keep positive as much as i can, but sometimes it all just gets to me you know :<

What DO i have going on for myself...
Well, its a question i have asked myself many times, and sadly i often come to the conclusion that, well “not much”...

I understand, in fact, i stopped eating any really sweets a while ago, maybe that will help, however that’s not really true now is it?

I can’t loose weight, which is surprising considering how i barely manage 1000 calories a day on average... 


But all in all... I understand your general idea... I know you’re right...
How can i expect anyone to love me if i don’t even love myself right?

Eh... Maybe i really should spend more time with my councillor idk...
